entries.note: Corrects the earlier 2026-09-13 entry, which recorded US$3/15 input/output (cache read 0.30, cache write 3.75). Claude Sonnet 5 is charged US$2/10 (cache read 0.20, 5-minute write 2.50, 1-hour write 4.00). The pricing page states that the US$2/10 launch pricing, introductory through 2026-08-31, is now the standard price and that the increase to US$3/15 scheduled for 2026-09-01 will not occur. Probable cause of the wrong entry (an inference, not verified): it recorded that cancelled increase. cache_creation_1h_price is recorded because it is the source's price, but build/generate_logbook_metrics.py does not split 5-minute from 1-hour cache writes, so it is not used: every cache write is priced at cache_creation_price.
